_schema.tolerance: numeric expected value e passes when |got - e| <= 1e-10*|e| + 1e-14; strings, booleans and null must match exactly; lists compare element-wise; dicts key-wise (every expected key).
_schema.number_encoding: finite numbers are JSON numbers: the 60-digit result rounded to the nearest IEEE double. Non-finite inputs are the strings 'NaN', 'Infinity', '-Infinity'. null = missing/None.
_schema.inputs: all numeric inputs are IEEE doubles; expected values are the exact mathematical result for those doubles (evaluated with mpmath at 60 digits), so T is given in years directly (T_minutes is info).
_schema.info: never scored: reason codes, the f64 twin's out-of-tolerance fields (conditioning), vega for IV cases.
_schema.ambiguity: list of AMBIGUITIES.md item ids whose chosen reading the expected value depends on.
